activity.notes: Logan was a leader among the Ohio Valley Mingo. ATLAS uses the directly attested 1774 retaliation and Dunmore's War activity as a representative point rather than inventing a continuous chiefly reign or asserting a disputed Indigenous personal name.

sources.title: Who Was Logan? — Colonial Williamsburg
sources.citation_text: Identifies Logan as a leader among the Mingo and explains that his 1774 retaliatory raids helped spark the Shawnee-Dunmore War; it also notes uncertainty over his full name.

sources.title: Chief Logan — West Virginia Encyclopedia
sources.citation_text: Documents Logan's 1774 raids after the Yellow Creek massacre and his role in the conflict.
